figures.finding: Gibraltar makes its own employment law, and no film, television or stage agreement or minimum was found there; the only pay floor is the standard minimum wage under the Conditions of Employment (Standard Minimum Wage) Order 2001, £9.50 an hour (£370.50 for a 39-hour week) from 1 August 2025, raised to £10 an hour in the 2026 Budget.

floor.name: Conditions of Employment (Standard Minimum Wage) Order, 2001 (LN.2001/065)

figures.applies: Gibraltar (British Overseas Territory), employees aged 15 and over; the 2025 schedule (LN 2025/138, from 1 August 2025) and the 2026 Budget rise to £10.

sources.said: Conditions of Employment (Standard Minimum Wage) Order, 2001 LN.2001/065 … 2025/138 Sch. 1.8.2025 … Standard Minimum Remuneration Rates Age 15 and over Amount Relevant calculation Hourly Remuneration £9.50 Weekly Remuneration £370.50 hourly remuneration x 39 Monthly Remuneration £1605.50
Gibraltar Budget 2026 includes important employment-related measures for employers and workers. The statutory minimum wage rises to £10 an hour

figures.finding: English is the official language of Gibraltar, by the government's fact sheet; many people also speak Spanish, and Llanito is a Gibraltarian dialect mixing the two.

sources.said: Language : English is the official language. Many people also speak Spanish. … Llanito is recognised as a specifically Gibraltarian dialect

figures.finding: Film work in Gibraltar is made in the territory itself; filming on government-controlled sites needs permission from the government's Press Office.

value.permit: HM Government of Gibraltar Press Office (government-controlled sites)

sources.said: The Government reiterates that filming on Government-controlled sites requires permission from the Press Office.
